का.आ. 1850 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. , जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , 
उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा झारखंड राज्य के गुमला जिले में NH - 143D के कि.मी. 69.200 से 
कि.मी .103.756 ( उपायुक्त कार्यालय , गुमला ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , 
अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 05.02.2023 
को " हिन्दुस्तान " और " दैनिक जागरण " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को 


( 1 ) 


अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


2 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा 
( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि 
सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 24th April , 2023 

S.O. 1850 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH - 143D on the 
stretch of land from Km 69.200 to Km 103.756 ( Dy Commissioner office , Gumla ) in the district of Gumla in the state 
of JHARKHAND ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

85 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Hindustan " and " Dainik Jagran " 
both dated 05.02.2023 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के बागलकोट जिले में NH 748A 
के कि.मी. 89 + 900 से कि . मी . 136 + 800 ( विशेष भूमि अधिग्रहण अधिकारी , एनएचएआई बगलकोट ) तक के राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से 
उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 19.05.2022 "

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर 
दिया है ;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

S.O. 1845 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH43 on the stretch 
of land from Km 0 to Km 32.4 ( Dy . Commissioner Office , Gumla ) in the district of Gumla in the state of 
JHARKHAND 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ PIONEER ” and “ SANMARG ” 
both dated 22.01.2023 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ;

New Delhi , the 24th April , 2023 

S.O. 1844 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport

( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of NH53 on the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km 3.5 ( Office of Sub Divisional Officer ( Revenue ) , 
Rajnandgaon ) in the district of Rajnandgaon in the state of CHHATTISGARH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " NewsPaper Navbharat ” and 
" Newspaper The Hitavada ” both dated 10 May 2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 1843 ( अ ) . – जबकि रेलवे मंत्रालय , भारत सरकार की अधिसूचना द्वारा एस . ओ . संख्या 6069 ( अ ) 
दिनांक - 16.12.2022 , भारत के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित , असाधारण , भाग || धारा 3 उप - धारा ( ii ) द्वारा संख्या - 5826 
दिनांक - 27.12.2022 रेलवे ( संशोधन ) अधिनियम , 2008 ( 2008 का 11 ) की धारा 20 ए की उप - धारा ( I ) के तहत ( यहाँ 
उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित ) , केंद्र सरकार ने अपना इरादा घोषित किया उक्त अधिसूचना में संलग्न अनुसूची में 
निर्दिष्ट भूमि का अधिग्रहण , विशेष रेलवे परियोजना - पश्चिम बंगाल के पश्चिम बर्धमान जिले में " अंडाल - सैंथिया बीजी बाई 
पास लाइन मौजूदा चौगुनी मुख्य लाइन से शाखा लाइन तक सीधा संपर्क " निर्माण के निष्पादन , रखरखाव , प्रबंधन और 
संचालन के लिए आवश्यक है । 


और जबकि उक्त नोटिफिकेशन का सामान्य सारांश दिनांक- 11.01.2023 को " एइ समय ” , “ संवाद प्रतिदिन ” 
और " दी टेलीग्राफ " में प्रकाशित किया गया है , जो उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20A की उपधारा ( 4 ) के तहत है ।

और जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को किसीभी व्यक्तिसे कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुआ है । 

और जबकि , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ( ई ) की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने अपनी रिपोर्ट 
केंद्र सरकार को प्रस्तुत कर दी है |

इसलिए अब , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की एक ही रिपोर्ट प्राप्त होने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उप 
धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्ति का प्रयोग करते हुए , केंद्र सरकार एतदद्वारा घोषित करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि 
उपरोक्त उद्देश्य के लिए अधिग्रहित किया जाएगा । 


और आगे , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में , केंद्र सरकार एतदद्वारा घोषणा 
करती है कि आधिकारिक राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि बिल्कुल केंद्र सरकार में 
निहित होगी सभी बंधनों से मुक्त ।

इसके पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार 
के सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या ( एस . ओ . संख्या 216 ) ( ई ) दिनांक 13.01.2023 ) , 
( एस . ओ . संख्या 3454 ( ई ) दिनांक 27.07.2022 ) , ( एस . ओ . संख्या 3838 ( ई ) दिनांक 16.08.2022 ) , 
( एस . ओ . संख्या 4470 ( ई ) दिनांक 22.09.2022 ) और ( एस.ओ. संख्या 3358 ( ई ) दिनांक 22.07.2022 ) जो भारत के 
राजपत्र , असाधारण , भारत II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा पश्चिम बंगाल राज्य के पूर्व बर्धमान 
जिले में NH116A कि.मी 90 से कि.मी. 162 ( कार्यालय जिला मजिस्ट्रेट एवं कलेक्टर , पूर्व बर्धमान , न्यायालय परिसर , 
बर्धमान ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ;

S.O. 1853 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport

16.08.2022 ) , ( S.O No 4470 ( E ) dated 22.09.2022 ) & ( S.O No 3358 ( E ) dated 22.07.2022 ) published in the Gazette of 
India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National 
Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its 
intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four 
laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH116A on the stretch of land from Km 90 to Km 162 
( Office of the District Magistrate & Collector , Purba Bardhaman , Court Compound , Burdwan ) in the district of 
PURBA BARDHAMAN in the state of WEST BENGAL 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in ( Bartaman and The Statesman both 
dated 29.01.2023 ) , ( Bartaman and The Times of India both dated 28.08.2022 ) , ( Bartaman and The Telegraph both 
dated 14.09.2022 ) , ( Bartaman and The Times of India both dated 14.10.2022 ) & ( Ananda Bazar Patrika and The Times 
of India both dated 21.09.2022 ) ; & under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

(i) अध्याय 4 की धारा 38 से धारा 43 तक और धारा 45H से धारा 5ज तक 

(ii) अध्याय 5 की धारा 46 से धारा 73 तक और

MINISTRY OF LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 1875(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 1 of the 
Employees’ State Insurance Act, 1948 (34 of 1948), the Central Government hereby appoints the 1st 
day of May, 2023, as the date on which the provisions of the said Act, namely,— 


(i) sections 38 to 43 and sections 45A to 45H of Chapter IV; 
(ii) sections 46 to 73 of Chapter V; and 
(iii) sections 74, 75, sub-sections (2) to (4) of section 76, 80, 82 and 83 of Chapter VI, 


shall come into force in all the areas of Kavaratti, Agatti and Minicoy Islands in the Union Territory of 
Lakshadweep.

का.आ. 1874 ( अ ) . – रेलवे अधिनियम 1989 ( 24 ) की धारा 20 ( A ) की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्ति का प्रयोग करते 
1989 का ) ( इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित ) , केन्द्र सरकार इस बात से संतुष्ट होने के बाद कि सार्वजनिक 
उददेश्य के लिए भूमि जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इसके साथ संलग्न अनुसूची में दिया गया है । विशेष रेलवे परियोजना के 
निष्पादन के लिए आवश्यक है , अर्थात , मध्यप्रदेश राज्य के बुरहानपुर जिला में खण्डवा - अकोला के मध्य अमान परिवर्ततन ( गेज 
कन्वर्जन ) कार्य हेतु एतद द्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की घोषणा करता है । 


उक्त भूमि में रूचि रखने वाला कोई भी व्यक्ति , प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस दिनों की अवधि के भीतर कर सकता 
है । इस अधिसूचना को राजपत्र में उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 डी की उपधारा ( 1 ) के तहत उक्त उददेश्य के लिए ऐसी भूमि 
के अधिग्रहण और उपयोग पर आपत्ति उठाएः 

ऐसी हर आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात प्रांत को की जाएगी । अनुविभागीय अधिकारी ( राजस्व ) नेपानगर जिला 
बुरहानपुर लिखित रूप में और उसके आधारो को निर्धारित करेगा । और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप से या 
कानूनी व्यवसायी द्वारा सुनवाई का अवसर देगा और ऐसी सभी आपत्तियों को सुनने के बाद और आगे ऐसा करने के बाद कर 
सकता है जॉच , यदि कोई हो , जैसा कि सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझ , आदेश द्वारा , आपत्तियों को या तो अनुमति दें या 
अस्वीकार करें । 

उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ( डी ) की उप - धारा ( द्वितीय ) के तहत सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा ।

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2lst April, 2023 


G.S.R. 3](E).—In exercise of the powers conferred on the Ministry of Railways (Railway Board), and in 
supersession of this Ministry’s Notifications dated the 07th August 2020 and 28th July 2022, the following 
Recruitment Rules are hereby made for the posts of Managing Director and five Directors in Centre for Railway 
Information Systems (CRIS), a society registered under the Societies Registration Act, XXI of 860. 


(l) Short title and commencement: 


(a) These rules may be called the “Recruitment Rules for the posts of (0) Managing Director (MD), 0॥) Director 
(Operations), (ii) Director (Passenger Systems) (iv) Director (Finance), (५) Director (Infrastructure) and (vi) Director 
(System) in Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS), 2023”. 


(b) These rules shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
(2) Title of the posts: 


(i) Managing Director (MD), CRIS; (i) Director (Operations), CRIS; (iii) Director (Passenger Systems), CRIS; (iv) 
Director (Finance), CRIS; (v) Director (Infrastructure), CRIS and (vi) Director (System), CRIS. 


(3) Pay Scale: 

(i) Managing Director : Rs.2,05,400-2,24,400/- (with Central DA) in Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. 
Gi) Directors : Rs. ,82,200-2,24,l00/- (with Central DA) in Level ]5 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. 

(4) Mode of appointment: 

Absorption/Deputation/Direct Recruitment. 

(5) Method of recruitment: 

(a) The posts shall be filled by the method of selection. 


(b) The Ministry of Railways shall constitute a Search- cum- Selection Committee for conducting selection to fill up 
vacancies of the posts of MD and all Directors. For the post of Managing Director, the Search-cum-Selection 
Committee shall comprise Chairman & CEO, Railway Board as Chairperson of the Committee and include Secretary, 
Department of Personnel & Training and Secretary, Ministry of Electronics & IT as Members. 


For the posts of Directors, the Search-cum-Selection Committee shall comprise Chairman & CEO, Railway Board as 
Chairperson of the Committee and include Secretary, Ministry of Electronics & IT and one Member of Railway 
Board. 


The Search-cum-Selection Committee may devise their own procedure for selection. 


The Committee shall recommend a suitable candidate for appointment and, if considered appropriate, another 
candidate in the standby panel. For the post of Managing Director, approval of the Appointments Committee of the 
Cabinet shall be required for the appointment. For the posts of Directors, approval of the Hon’ble Minister of 
Railways shall be required for the appointment. 


(c) The panel recommended by the Search-cum-Selection Committee shall be valid for one year. 
(6) Employment status: 


The applicant must, on the date of application, as well as on the date of personal interaction (Gf any), be employed in a 
regular capacity — and not in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity — in one of the followings:- 


(a) Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) (including a full-time functional Director in the Board of a CPSE); 
(b) Central Government including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services; 


(c) State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) where the annual turnover is *Rs 2000 crore or more for Managing Director 
and *Rs.l000 crore or more for Directors; 


(d) Private Sector company where the annual turnover is *Rs 2000 crore or more for the post of Managing Director 
and *Rs.l000 crore or more for Directors. Preference would be given to candidates from listed Companies. 


(* The average audited annual turnover of three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is 
advertised shall be considered for applying the approved limits)

(e) All eligible serving Railway officers as also officers working as Directors in CRIS on absorption basis would be 
considered as internal candidates. 


(7) Qualification: 
(i) 
For Managing Director and all Directors (other than Director/Finance): 


Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication or Information Technology or 
Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Electrical and Electronics or Electronics or Master’s Degree in 
Computer Applications from a recognized Institution. 


For Director (Finance): 


Bachelors Degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance with good academic record from recognized University or 
Masters/MBA in Finance/Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant. 


(ii) Applicants from the Central Govt./Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services will be exempted from the 
educational qualification as per (i) above provided the applicants have the relevant experience as mentioned in Para 8 
(A) (i), Para 8 (B) (i) and Para 8 (C) (i) below. 


(8) Experience: 


(A) For Managing Director: 


(i) Applicants from Central Govt./Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services should possess adequate experience 
at a senior level of management in a large organization of repute. Professional experience in and exposure to IT 
systems including design development and implementation of IT systems would be given due weightage during 
selection. 


(ii) Applicants from CPSEs/SPSEs/Private Sector should possess minimum 25 years of experience in the area of 
Information Technology or System Implementation of which at least 5 years as the Chief Executive of an Information 
Technology related organization during the preceding ten years. 


(B) For all Directors (other than Director/Finance): 


(i) Applicants from Central Government/Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services should possess adequate 
experience at a senior level of management in a large organization of repute. Academic Background & Professional 
experience and exposure to IT systems including design development and implementation of IT systems/Software 
would be given due weightage during selection. 


(ii) Applicants from CPSEs/SPSEs/Private Sector should possess minimum 20 years of experience in the area of 
Information Technology or System Implementation of which at least 3 years should be at senior management level in 
an Information Technology related organization during the preceding ten years. 


(C) For Director (Finance): 


(i) Applicants from Central Government/Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services should possess adequate 
experience at a senior level of management in a large organization of repute. Academic background and Professional 
experience and exposure to Financial Management, Accounting and dealing with financing institutions, would be 
given due weightage during selection. 


(ii) Applicants from CPSEs/SPSEs/Private Sector should possess minimum 20 years of experience in the area of 
Financial Systems and Accounting of which at least 3 years should be at senior management level in commercial 
accounting/company accounts and experience in dealing with tenders/contracts during the preceding ten years. 


(9) Eligible Pay Scales: 


(A) For Managing Director: 


(i) Applicants from Central Government/All India Services should be holding a post of the level of Additional 
Secretary in Government of India or carrying equivalent scale of pay on regular basis on the date of application. 


(ii) Applicants from the Armed Forces of the Union should be holding a post of the level of Lt. General in the Army 
or equivalent rank in Navy/Air Force on the date of application. 


(iii) Applicants from CPSEs should be working in the scale of pay of Rs.62,000-80,000/- (IDA — post 0.0.2007) or 
7६. | ,50,0000-3,00,00000)/- (DA post 0.0.207) or higher.

(iv) Applicants from Autonomous Bodies/Societies under the Central/State Government in HAG equivalent grade/pay 
scale on regular basis or higher would be eligible. 


(v) Applicants from State Public Sector Enterprises/Private Sector should be working at a Board level position on the 
date of application. 


(vi) Government officers working on deputation in PSUs/ autonomous bodies etc. would be treated at par with their 
peers in the parent cadre and on the basis of their substantive grade/ pay scale in the parent cadre. 


(B) For all Directors: 


(i) Applicants from Central Government/All India Services should be holding a post of the level of Joint 
Secretary in Government of India or carrying equivalent scale of pay on regular basis on the date of application. 


(ii) Applicants from the Armed Forces of the Union should be holding a post of the level of Major General in the 
Army or equivalent rank in Navy/Air force on the date of application. 


(iii) Applicants from CPSEs should be working in the scale of pay of Rs. 5,300-73,000/- DA — post

(iv) Applicants from Autonomous Bodies/Societies under the Central/State Government in SAG equivalent 
grade/pay scale on regular basis or higher would be eligible. 


(v) Applicants from the State Public Sector Enterprises/Private Sector should be working at Board level position 
or at a post immediately below the Board level on the date of application. 


(vi) Government officers working on deputation in PSUs/autonomous bodies etc. would be treated at par with 
their peers in the parent cadre and on the basis of their substantive grade/pay scale in the parent cadre. 


(0) Age Limit: 
Not more than 56 years for internal candidates and 55 years for others as on the closing date of the Vacancy Notice. 
() Period of Appointment: 


The period of appointment shall be 5 years or till the officer attains the age of superannuation or until further orders, 
whichever is the earliest. The age of superannuation will be 60 years. 


(/2) Extension of tenure: 


For Managing Director, the authority to approve extension of tenure will vest in the ACC. For Directors, the authority 
to approve extension of tenure will vest in the Hon’ble Minister of Railways. 


(I3) Powers to relax/modify: 
Authority to relax and/or modify these Rules shall vest in the Central Government, i.e. Ministry of Railways. 
(4) Note: 


(a) Applicants would be required to submit applications in the prescribed format and state in detail the work done and 
experience gained in the relevant field. They would also be required to submit documents in support of their 
eligibility. 

(b) Applicants from Government Service, Public Sector Undertakings and Autonomous Bodies/ Societies will be 


required to submit their applications through proper channel along with relevant documents including service 
certificate and attested copies of APARs. 


(c) Cut off date for eligibility will be the closing date for submission of applications as per the Vacancy Notice.

GSR. 32(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Central Civil Accounts Service (Private Secretary) Recruitment Rules, 2002 except as respects 
things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating 
the method of recruitment to the post of Private Secretary in the Central Civil Accounts Service, namely:- 


4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(i)] 


l. Short title and Commencement—(|) These rules may be called the Central Civil Accounts Service 
(Private Secretary) Group “B’ post, Recruitment Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of posts, classification and level in the pay matrix.— The number of post, its classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc—The method of recruitment, age limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the aforesaid Schedule. 


4. Liability for service in any part of परातवा4-- () The Private Secretary shall be liable to serve in any part of 
India. 


(2) The Controller General of Accounts may, if satisfied that it is necessary or expedient in public interest so 
to do, by order, and for reasons to be recorded in writing, transfer the Private Secretary on request by officer from one 
Ministry to the other in the same grade. The transfer of the Private Secretary in such cases shall not affect his or her 
seniority in his or her grade. 


5. Disqualification— No person,— 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage, and that there are other grounds for so doing, 
exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Power to relax—— Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, 
it may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


7. Savings.—Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, ex-servicemen 
and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to 
time in this regard.

the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project namely, Eastern 
Dedicated Freight Corridor in the district of Prayagraj in the State of Uttar Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of Section 20D of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard either in person or by legal practitioner and may after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry if any as the Competent Authority thinks necessary by order either 
allow or disallow the objections; 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of Section 20D of the said Act shall be final; 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 1877(E).— Whereas by the notification No. 5.0. 3556 (E) of the Government of India in the Ministry of 
Road Transport and Highways, published on the 29-07-2022, in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning/ six-laning, etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of Newly Proposed Ahmedabad - Dholera Expressway(New National Highway no.751) on 
the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km 71.070 in the district of Ahmedabad in the state of GUJARAT. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “GUJARAT SAMACHAR” and 
“INDIAN EXPRESS” newspapers dated 7 AUGUST 2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in the exercise of powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on the publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 25th April , 2023 

S.O. 1876 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways S.O No. 2088 ( E ) dated 05.05.2022 published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , 
maintenance , management and operation of Zirakpur Bypass National Highway No. ( Yet to be Assigned ) Km . 0.000 
to Km . 19.000 ( Starting from the junction with Chandigarh -Rajpura -Patiala NH - 7 and ending at Zirakpur 
Parwanoo NH - 5 ) along with connecting between Yamunanagar - Panchkula NH - 344 and NH - 5 in the district of S.A.S 
Nagar Mohali in the state of PUNJAB ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Times of India ( English " and " Ajit 
( Punjabi ) " both dated 13.05.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 1883 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का . आ . 4391 ( अ ) दिनांक 20 सितम्बर 2022 , जो भारत के 
राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के महबूबनगर जिले में 
जड़चेर्ला - कलवाकुरति सेक्शन के NH - 167 के कि.मी. 17.0 से कि.मी. 18.0 ( एडिशनल कलेक्टर , रेवेन्यू महबूबनगर ) तक 
के भूखण्ड पर निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन / 4 - लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी 
; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " समाचार 
18 अक्टूबर 2022 " को " नमस्ते तेलंगाना " ( तेलुगु ) और " द हिन्दू " ( अंग्रेजी ) दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी को किसी भी यक्ति से कोई आक्षेप प्राप्त नहीं हुए थे ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


2 


[ PART II — SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

S.O. 1879 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH17 on the stretch 
of land from Km 99.930 to Km 143.680 ( Design Ch . 96.000K to Ch.139.750 Km ) , from Paikan to Dhupdhara Sahar 
( DC Office Goalpara ) , NH17 in the district of GOALPARA in the State of ASSAM 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Niyomiyabarta " and " The Assam 
Tribune ” both dated 11.02.2023 & 12.02.2023 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ;

Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2126 ( अ ) दिनांक 06 मई , 2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र ,

कि.मी. 73.6 से कि.मी. 103.3 ( कार्यालय उपखण्ड अधिकारी जालोर ) तक के भूखण्ड पर टोल प्लाजा के निर्माण , 
अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 25th April , 2023 

S.O. 1885 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O.2126 ( E ) Dated 06th May , 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 
3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance , management and operation 
of NH325 on the stretch of land from Km . 73.6 to Km . 103.3 ( SDO OFFICE JALORE ) in the district of JALORE in 
the state of RAJASTHAN ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Dainik Bhaskar ” and “ Rajasthan 
Patrika ” both dated 02.06.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 1880(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, $.0.3979 dated on 23rd August 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning, 
etc.,), Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of Siddipet-Elkathurthy Section of NH-765DG on the 
stretch of land from Km 116.063 to Km 133.619 (RDO-Hanumakonda) in the district of WARANGAL 
URBAN/HANUMAKONDA in the state of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu”’(English) and 
“Namasthe Telangana” (Telugu) both dated 31.08.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 88l(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways,S.O.No.5l8 dated 2nd February,2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning, 
etc.,),of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of Khammam-Kurvi Section of NH-365A on the stretch 
of land from Km 34.250 to Km 49.45 (Revenue Division Office, Khammam) in the district of KHAMMAM in the 
state of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” (English) and 
“Namasthe Telangana” (Telugu) both dated l3th February 2023 under sub-section (3) of Section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 1898(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH30 in the 
stretch of land from Km 170.700 to Km 234.567 (Bhadrachalam to Kunta) in the district of Alluri Sitharama Raju in 
the state of ANDHRA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, the Sub Collector, chinturu in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 


NOTIFICATION 


New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


S.O. 1896(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(Construction of Major Bridge RET), maintenance, management and operation of NH26 in the stretch of land from 
Km 149.988 to Km150.087 (Kesinga) in the district of KALAHANDI in the state of ODISHA, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Tahasildar, Kesinga in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 1882 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4844 ( अ ) , तारीख 12.10.2022 जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के गुंटूर जिले में ( कोंडामुडु से 
पेरीचेरला ) राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग सं 167 एजी के कि.मी. 37.900 से कि . मी . 48.985 तक के भूखण्ड के निर्माण , अनुरक्षण , 
प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 17.10.2022 " 
को " आंध्र प्रभा " और " द हिन्दू " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


2 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th April, 2023 


8७.0. 1902(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule 
below, is required for building (widening/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of 
National Highway No.42 in the stretch of land for the work of "Construction of 4 lane with paved shoulders 
bypasses of V.Kota of NH-42 from KM.333/400 to KM.340/900 in the State of Andhra Pradesh on EPC 
Mode" in the district of KOLAR in the state of KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire 
such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


[भाग व---खण्ड 3(॥)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 5 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition 
Officer, NH Bangalore in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall 
give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after 
hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 1900 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
जाने के पश्चात् कि कर्नाटक राज्य के बल्लारी जिले में NH150A के किमी 187.92 से किमी 198.92 ( वेंकटेश्वर कैंप से 
डेडसुगुर कैंप सेक्शन ) के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन / 4 - लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् स्पेशल लैंड एक्कीजीशन अफसर धारवाड़ को लिखित रूप में 
प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में 
या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच 
करने के पश्चात् , यदि कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा ।

New Delhi , the 25th April , 2023 

S.O. 1900 ( E ) .– In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH150A in 
the stretch of land from Km 187.70 to Km 198.92 ( Venkateshwara Camp to Dadesugur Camp Section ) in the district 
of BALLARI in the state of KARNATAKA , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , Special Land Acquisition Officer 
Dharwad in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an

b .

Transactions under long term contracts ( where period of the contract of the Trading Licensee with

Banking of electricity , irrespective of duration of the contract ; 

Transactions under Back to Back contracts , irrespective of duration of the contract ; 


The trading margin shall be charged on the scheduled quantity of electricity 

The trading margin shall include all charges , except the charges for scheduled energy , open access 
and transmission losses : 


Provided that the charges for open access include the transmission charge , operating charge and the 
application fee . 


For transactions under short term and Long term contracts and contracts through power exchanges 
up to one year , the Trading Licensee shall charge a trading margin of not less than zero ( 0.0 ) 
paisa / kWh and not exceeding four ( 4.0 ) paisa / kWh : 


Provided that in contracts where escrow arrangement or irrevocable , unconditional and revolving 
letter of credit equivalent to one point one ( 1.1 ) times the average monthly bill amount ( estimated 
average of monthly billing amounts for three months or actual monthly billing amount for preceding 
three months as the case may be ) in case of long term contract with a validity of one year is not 
provided by the Trading Licensee in favour of the seller , the Trading Licensee shall not charge 
trading margin exceeding Two ( 2.0 ) paisa / kWh . 


2. The trading margin specified under these regulations shall be the cumulative value of the trading margin 
charged by all the traders involved in the chain of transactions between the generator and the 
ultimate buyer , that is to say , trading margin in case of multiple trader - to - trader transactions and 
shall not exceed the ceiling of trading margin specified under these regulations .

10. Contravention of terms and conditions of licence 

The Commission may pass such orders as it deems fit in accordance with the provisions of the Act , if there is 
a contravention or the likelihood of a contravention of the terms and conditions of licence by the Licensee . 

11. Refusal of Licence 


The Licensee will supply information in the format prescribed at Annexure - 3 to these Regulations 
to the State Load Despatch Centre ( SLDC ) or any other utility as may be specified by the 
Commission with a copy to the Commission , on quarterly basis and also post on the website . 


If the Commission is not inclined to grant the Licence , the Commission shall give an opportunity to the 
Applicant for being heard in person before rejecting the application . 

12. Revocation of a Licence 


The Commission may , after consultation with the licensee , specify the standards of performance of 
the licensee . 


The licensee will furnish performance details to the Commission on quarterly basis in the format 
prescribed in Annexure - 4 to these Regulations . 


The proceedings for revocation of a Licence and / or for issuing any other orders under section 19 of 
the Act shall be initiated by the Commission by means of an order . The Commission may initiate 
such proceedings suo motu or on application of the licensee or on receiving any complaint or 
information from any person . 


The Commission shall give notice of the proceedings for the revocation of the licence to the licensee 
and to such other person , authority or body as the Commission may consider appropriate . 


Subject to the provisions of the Act and the procedure prescribed therein , the inquiry by the 
Commission for revocation of the licence , in so far as it is applicable , shall be in the same manner as 
provided in the Conduct of Business Regulations of the Commission in force . 


If the Commission decides to revoke the licence , the Commission shall communicate the order of 
revocation to the licensee stating the date from which such revocation shall take effect . 


The Commission may instead of revoking the licence pass any other order imposing such terms or 
conditions subject to which the Licensee is permitted to operate thereafter .

or direct .

का.आ. 1927 ( अ ) . – केंद्रीय सरकार , रेल अधिनियम , 1989 ( 1989 का 24 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात् उक्त 
अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 20 क के उपखंड ( I ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुये , ये समाधान हो जाने के 
पश्चात् कि लोक प्रयोजन के लिए , यह भूमि , जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में दिया गया है , गुजरात राज्य 
में जिला पाटन में महेसाणा पालनपुर दोहरीकरण परियोजना नाम की विशेष रेल परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिये 
आवश्यक है , ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा करती है ; 


उक्त भूमि के लिये इछक कोई व्यक्ति , राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर , 
उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 घ की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन उपर्युक्त प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन और उपयोग के 
संबंध में आक्षेप कर सकेगा । 


प्रत्येक ऐसा आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात् , प्रांत अधिकारी , सिद्धपुर , जिला पाटन को लिखित रूप में किया 
जाएगा जो कि आक्षेप का आधार होगा । सक्षम प्राधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रुप से या कानुनी प्रेक्टिशनर के माध्यम 
से सुनवाई का अवसर प्रदान करेगा और सभी ऐसे आक्षेपों की सुनवाई और जांच करने के पश्चात् , यदि आवश्यक समझे तो , 
आदेश द्वारा या तो आक्षेपों के लिये अनुमति देगा या अनुमति प्रदान नहीं करेगा ।

S.O. 96(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways

(Revenue)Bijawar), in the district of CHHATARPUR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) 
Bijawar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 26th April, 2023 


S.O. 1912(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four lanning/six lanning with paved shoulder/Toll plaza/service Road,etc), 
maintenance, management and operation of the National Highway No. 8A (New NH No.47) in the stretch of land 
from (Km. 160.1 to Km.180 (PRANT ADHIKARI OFFICE CHOTILA) in the district of SURENDRANAGAR in the 
state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, PRANT ADHIKARI OFFICE 
CHOTILA) in the district of SURENDRANAGAR in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, 
after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry,if any, as the Competent Authority thinks 
necessary, by order,either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ;

submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers
